title: Rav Nachumi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Bava Batra 131a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.131a.13) mentions him raising a difficulty against Abaye. [Eruvin 71b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.71b.12) has a dispute between Rav Nachumi and Rabbah; Hyman thinks that passage should read Rav Rachumi, as in the Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim, and describes those disputants as Saboraic rabbis.[^1][^2]
We also find Rav Minyumi, son of Rav Nachumi, in [Ketubot 69a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.69a.11).[^3]

notes.text: Bava Batra reads Rav Nachumi, or Rav Chananya bar Minyumi. The objection to Abaye continues at [the start of 131b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.131b.1).
Eruvin reads Rabbi Nachumi. Hyman proposes Rachumi on the basis of the Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim and assigns the disputants to the Saboraic period.
Hyman gives Ketubot 69 without a side. The matching report is at 69a and names Rav Minyumi son of Rav Nichumi.
